speaker: NARRATOR
text: What if you were the world's best assassin... and you were sixteen?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: By day, you fail Spanish quizzes. By night, they call you... Red Band.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Nobody's ever seen your face. Nobody's ever heard you coming.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: And you have one rule. Nobody gets hurt.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Your targets just wake up tied to a chair, with a sticky note.

speaker: MOM
text: Where are you? It's a school night!

speaker: YOU
text: Library, Mom.

speaker: MOM
text: The library closes at eight.

speaker: YOU
text: ...Really big library.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Every morning, you sneak back in through your window before she wakes up.

speaker: MOM
text: You look tired, sweetie.

speaker: YOU
text: Studying. Hard.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Weird. You didn't even see her move.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Twenty missions. Zero mistakes. Then your boss calls you in.

speaker: HANDLER
text: One last job, Red Band. Biggest payout in history.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You open the folder... and freeze.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: The target... is your mom.

speaker: HANDLER
text: She's not who you think she is, kid.

speaker: YOU
text: Find someone else.

speaker: HANDLER
text: Already did. They're on their way.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You've never run so fast in your life.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Six men surround your house. Lights off. Total silence.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: You burst through the kitchen door, ready for anything...

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Except this.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Every single one of them is tied to a chair. With a sticky note.

speaker: MOM
text: Pancakes?

speaker: YOU
text: Mom... what is this?

speaker: MOM
text: You really thought you invented the sticky note?

speaker: NARRATOR
text: Twenty years ago, the world's best assassin vanished. No face. No name. Just a sticky note.

speaker: NARRATOR
text: She retired... and had a kid.

speaker: YOU
text: How long have you known?

speaker: MOM
text: Since your first mission. Who do you think kept turning off the alarms?

speaker: MOM
text: Library closes at eight, by the way. You're grounded.
